About Me

Hey there, stranger, glad you wandered in! I'm Ying Hui, a Malaysian girl 🇲🇾 who somehow turned a love for math and puzzles into a career in data. I picked up my BEng and MSc in Electrical Engineering from the University of Malaya and KAIST along the way.

These days you'll find me as a data scientist at Singtel in sunny Singapore 🇸🇬, where I turn messy customer data into models that actually help people (and the business) make smarter decisions. Before that, I was an AI Engineer at Lauretta, teaching computers to "see" for security and analytics.

When I'm off the clock, I'm probably planning my next trip, wandering through museums for Renaissance art and sculptures 🏛️ (Florence 🇮🇹 has my whole heart), getting way too invested in a movie 🎬, curled up with a good book 📚, or slowly teaching myself French 🇫🇷 (on est en train d'apprendre!). If anything here sparks your curiosity or you just want to say hi, feel free to drop me a line at yinghui.t@outlook.com or come hang out on LinkedIn

Thanks for stopping by (: hope your day is as bright as this little sun. 🌞
